chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, and a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Abi Nasr, all from Jamil ibn Darraj, from Zurara, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
The Quroo (menses-free period) is what is between the two menstruations.

key_terms.الْقُرْءُ: The period of purity between menstruations; also refers to the menstruation itself in other contexts.

ai.seo_question: What is the definition of Al-Quroo in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the jurisprudential definition of 'Al-Quroo' as the interval of purity between two menstrual cycles, a key concept for determining a woman's ritual state. Rooted in the chain of the Six Companions, it reflects the Imami scholarly tradition's precise delineation of menstrual phases for calculating prayer obligations and marital validity. This definition aligns with the broader Quranic discourse on purity and divorce waiting periods, emphasizing the cyclical nature of female physiology in Islamic law.
